# Date Time Picker

Choose a local date and time with coordinated field and calendar controls.

## Usage

### Schedule

Choose a deployment date and wall-clock time together.

<ComponentExample component="date-time-picker" scenario="schedule" title="Schedule" description="Choose a deployment date and wall-clock time together." :index="0" />

### Morning

Choose a morning date and time as one local schedule value.

<ComponentExample component="date-time-picker" scenario="morning" title="Morning" description="Choose a morning date and time as one local schedule value." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="date-time-picker" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | Move the highlighted date by one day or one week. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the start or end of the week. |
| <kbd>Page Up</kbd> / <kbd>Page Down</kbd> | Move by one month; hold Shift to move by one year. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the highlighted date. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the calendar without selecting another date. |

## Accessibility

Date and time inputs remain labeled while the popup calendar uses grid semantics and an explicit trigger.
